title: VibeFit
intro: An app that lets you and your partner find the right outfits for the evening's vibe, together

sections.caption: Step 1: Choose the vibe for the night
Step 2: Get inspiration for your outfit that fits your vibe.
Step 3: Get styling tips, see versions of this look on Pinterest, or figure out how to use items you have in your closet
Share with a partner to sync your vibe and fits for the night
Add clothes you have to Your Closet to make the app more tailored to your style
